sens_en: to tighten, to rein in, to force
origine_fr: Le cuir 革, avec 力 à droite, qui donnait le son mais se lit lì aujourd'hui. Au départ, 勒 est la bride du cheval avec son mors. La bride serre : serrer, 勒紧, et contraindre, 勒索, extorquer.
origine_en: Leather 革, with 力 on the right, which gave the sound but now reads lì. At first 勒 is a horse's bridle with its bit. The bridle grips: to tighten, 勒紧, and to force, 勒索, to extort.
